citations.excerpt: The Mennonite Brethren Church of North America (Bruedergemeinde) was founded by Pastor Edward Wuest in 1860 and came to the United States in 1879 under the leadership of Abraham Schellenberg.

facts.value: Founded in 1860 and came to the United States in 1879. Now known as the U.S. Conference of Mennonite Brethren Churches.

citations.excerpt: Today it is known as the U.S. Conference of Mennonite Brethren Churches.
